profile.headline: Engineering at Netflix
profile.summary: Seasoned software engineer with over 10 years of experience developing distributed systems. Proficient in a variety of languages and technologies - continuously learning. Passionate in improving everyday and driven by a commitment to excellence.

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Commerce/Payments
positions.description:
* Designed and developed the new subscription and tracking services for facilitating the Google Play and App Store subscription interactions
* Led and completed the payments migration from the old python monolith application to a new Java based micro-services system
* Led seller tax initiative and rollout. Gathered metrics for affected user requirements. Implemented features to support generating seller tax documentation
* Contributed to the successful development and release of the new OfferUp’s billing system for handling recurring and balance threshold invoices
* Maintained and supported  payment services  to detect and mitigate fraudulent transactions
* Started and led a weekly cloud engineering seminar to train peers in AWS cloud technologies such as DynamoDB, SQS, API Gateway, etc.
* Advocated and introduced processes to improve the code quality and productivity (e.g.: retrospectives meetings, test coverage, test automation, and branching strategy)

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
* Led the development of the professional seller search for annoncesbateau.com web portal
* Collaborated on different customer facing web portals and used AWS Services to make the portals highly available
* Architected and developed the redesign of the YachtWorld.com search results page transitioning the portal from Java/Spring to Node/ReactJS
* Designed and developed reusable components for handling Integrated Google Ads, Prebid, and Google Analytics
Designed, developed and maintained reliable and robust micro-services using AWS ECS, hapi.js and DynamoDB
* Participated on software architecture meetings to help design future software to be developed
* Served as a technical resource and mentored junior and mid level developers in growing their technical skills

positions.title: Sr. Web Applications Developer
positions.description:
* Contributed on the company initiative of making ncl.com a responsive website
* Developed the newly redesigned booking funnel which resulted in an increase in performance and experience. The new funnel was developed using technologies such as AngularJS, Bootstrap and Scala with Play Framework
* Architected and developed air integration into ncl.com website in order to simplify the process of booking a flight  together with a cruise reservation
* Created and implemented a plan for improving ncl.com PageSpeed score by restructuring how the developers created and deployed front end code and styles
* Trained and assisted new developers by providing them with the tools and knowledge for them to succeed in the company

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Coached the newly formed development team about best practices and how to get started with Scrum as a SDLC
* Introduced best practices for releasing software from branching strategies to CI/CD using TeamCity and Octopus Deploy
* Architected and developed an e-signature integration portal for automating sending documents for signature using DocuSign. Used technologies like C#, NancyFX with Autofac, MongoDB and RabbitMQ
* Developed and maintained RESTful web services and SPA portals

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected and developed horizontally-scalable software integration with FedEx and UPS named Magaya Express Link, and used technologies like C#, MongoDB and MSMQ
* Developed Directed Operations (Directed Put-away and Directed Picking) for the Magaya WMS Software. Theses operations automate the creation of  many of the warehouse tasks
* Applied design patterns such as abstract factory, façade, and strategy to allow code reusability and decouple subsystems
